description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- docs: update install guide (#12)
- bug: fix crash on empty input (#7)
- refactor: split parser module (#9)
- feature: add dark mode (#3)
- bug: handle timeout in sync (#15)
- feature: add export to CSV (#4)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)', grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group (FEAT: dark mode then CSV export; FIX: empty input crash then sync timeout; DOCS: install guide; CHORE: parser split).

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add keyboard shortcuts (#21)
- bug: fix typo in error message
evals.expected_output: '- [FEAT] Add keyboard shortcuts (#21)' followed by '- [FIX] Fix typo in error message (#none)'.
